1: It is a positive Biblical commandment to reside in Eretz Yisrael, as it says "and you shall possess it and dwell in it" (Deuteronomy 26:6). And they [ – the sages – ], peace be upon them, said that this Mitzvah is weighed against [i.e. equal to] all of the Mitzahs in the Torah (Sifre Devarim Piska 80). And they said: anyone who leaves Eretz Yisrael and dwells outside of the land, they should be in your eyes as a worshipper of false worships, as it says "For they have driven me out this day that I should not cleave to the inheritance of Hashem, saying: Go, serve other gods" (I Samuel 26:19) (Bavli Ketuvot 110b). And it appears in Masechet [Bava] Batra that Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai said that Elimelech, Machlon, and Kilyon were punished because they left from Eretz Yisrael to outside of the land, as it says "The whole city buzzed over them, and said "Is this Na'omi?"" (Ruth 1:19). Rabbi Yitzchak said: they said "have you seen Na'omi, who left from Eretz Yisrael to outside of the land, what happend to her?". And why were they punished? Because they should have requested mercy over the people of their generation, and they didn't request. (Bava Batra 91a) Until here [is the quote]. [And it is] from the 613 [biblical Mitzahs] in [the list of] the Ramban and in [the list of] the Rashbatz.
